item.title: Woman dies following hit-and-run crash in northeast Minneapolis
item.description: Police say they're looking for the driver who hit and killed a woman early Sunday morning in northeast Minneapolis.

item.title: The Latest: Pakistan’s prime minister says his nation is ready to facilitate talks to end Iran war
item.description: Pakistan’s prime minister says his country is ready to “facilitate meaningful and conclusive talks” to end the Iran war. Pakistan is one of the countries pushing diplomatically for talks between Iran and the United States after President Donald Trump said there were ongoing negotiations between Washington and Tehran. item.title: Springsteen to sing at No Kings rally in St. Paul, joining growing list
item.description: Bruce Springsteen will sing "Streets of Minneapolis," a song he wrote and released back in January about the ICE surge in Minnesota, at the No Kings rally this weekend in St. Paul.

item.title: MPD: Man and woman injured, both arrested after stabbing in Bryant neighborhood
item.description: Police say a man suffered "at least one potentially life-threatening stab wound" in an apparent domestic dispute in Minneapolis that led officers to arrest him and a woman.

item.title: Trivia Tuesday: Ramsey County
item.description: Producer Betsy Melin puts the hosts to the test on their knowledge of Ramsey County.

item.title: Spring Adventures Across Minnesota
item.description: From scenic trails to cozy indoor escapes, Explore Minnesota’s Jake Juliot shares fresh ideas to help you make the most of the new season. Whether you're ready to get outside after the spring equinox or prefer to ease in indoors, there’s something for everyone across the state.

item.title: Declutter Your Home This Spring
item.description: Spring cleaning is in full swing, and Cori McDougald of Meat & Potatoes Organizing is sharing practical ways to simplify your space. From smart storage solutions to easy decluttering tips, she’s helping you refresh your home for the new season.

item.title: The Art of Glass Blowing
item.description: Glass blowing is an extraordinary art form that’s capturing hearts on the Netflix show Blown Away. This mesmerizing reality series comes to life through the skilled hands of local glass blower Dante Germain. Kelli Hanson takes us on a vivid journey to Dante’s Minneapolis studio where his stunning creations are crafted.

item.title: Game time set for Gophers-Bruins Sweet 16 matchup
item.description: Coming off a dramatic last-second game-winner over Ole Miss, the Minnesota Gophers women's basketball team will now head west to face UCLA in the Sweet 16.
